## The Freedom Bag Tag {#freedom-bag-tag}

### Keep seeds free for future generations

Commercial seed packets often come with a “bag tag” that prohibits saving,
replanting, or sharing seeds. The Freedom Bag Tag turns that logic around. It is
an adhesion contract that takes effect when the packet is opened and is designed
to keep the seeds and everything bred from them open to all.

### The Freedom Bag Tag (V.2)

One of Copyleft Cultivars' primary tools for seed sovereignty is the Freedom Bag
Tag. It demonstrates an alternative to restrictive commercial bag tags through
an adhesion contract with three binding terms:

- **No privatization:** Third parties' use of these seeds or their derivatives
  may not be restricted through patents, plant breeders' rights, or other
  intellectual or industrial property rights.
- **The terms travel with the seed:** Any transfer, assignment, or conveyance of
  the seeds or their derivatives must include these same terms, without
  exception.
- **Shared sequencing data:** If the resulting material is genetically
  sequenced, that sequence and relevant supporting data must be submitted to
  Copyleft Cultivars under a copyleft-type agreement.

### Full text in Spanish

> “Al abrir este paquete de semillas, usted acepta los presentes términos de afirmación de libertad
> (“los Términos”). Usted tiene la libertad de utilizar estas semillas de libertad afirmada (“las
> Semillas”) de cualquier forma que elija. Con el fin de preservar estas libertades, usted se obliga
> a no restringir, por ningún medio de privatización o de apropiación exclusiva de derechos
> (incluyendo, sin limitación, patentes, derechos de obtentor vegetal, u otros derechos de propiedad
> intelectual o industrial), el uso que terceros hagan de estas Semillas o de sus derivados, y a
> incluir los presentes Términos en toda transferencia, cesión o transmisión de estas Semillas o de
> sus derivados. Para contribuir a la comunidad, usted se obliga a que, en caso de realizarse la
> secuenciación genética de la totalidad o de una parte del ADN del material vegetal resultante del
> cultivo de estas Semillas o de sus derivados, dicha secuencia sea remitida a Copyleft Cultivars
> (una organización sin fines de lucro constituida y domiciliada en el Estado de Oregón, Estados
> Unidos de América), junto con los datos complementarios pertinentes y el correspondiente acuerdo
> de tipo copyleft.”

### English translation

> “By opening this seed package, you accept these freedom affirmation terms (the “Terms”). You are
> free to use these freedom-affirmed seeds (the “Seeds”) in any way you choose. In order to preserve
> these freedoms, you agree not to restrict, by any means of privatization or exclusive
> appropriation of rights (including, without limitation, patents, plant breeders' rights, or other
> intellectual or industrial property rights), the use that third parties make of these Seeds or
> their derivatives, and to include these Terms in any transfer, assignment, or conveyance of these
> Seeds or their derivatives. To contribute to the community, you agree that, should the whole or
> any part of the DNA of the plant material resulting from the cultivation of these Seeds or their
> derivatives be genetically sequenced, that sequence shall be submitted to Copyleft Cultivars (a
> nonprofit organization incorporated and domiciled in the State of Oregon, United States of
> America), together with the relevant supporting data and the corresponding copyleft-type
> agreement.”

### How the tag works in practice

The Freedom Bag Tag works primarily as a norm-setting instrument, modeled on
early open-source software licenses. It communicates clear expectations and
discourages privatization through reputation and transparency, whether or not
every clause would hold up in formal litigation in a given jurisdiction. Anyone
can use the Freedom Bag Tag on seed packets for newly bred varieties.

### Submitting genetic data for Freedom Bag Tag cultivars

We are developing governance protocols for our Genomic Galaxy, where genetic
data from Freedom Bag Tag cultivars will be published. We will post further
information as this work progresses. In the meantime, here is a snapshot of what
to expect when submitting genetic data for a Freedom Bag Tag plant friend.

A dedicated email address for submissions will be posted here. Once it is
available, please email the data in a standard format (such as FASTA, FASTQ, VCF,
or an SNP genotyping report) along with the cultivar name. Include the testing
lab or platform, the date of testing, and where the seed came from, if known. We
will reply with the copyleft-type agreement that accompanies your submission.
